subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding interest at a basic level: a bank pays you a little extra for keeping your money saved there
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student watches a simple simulated savings balance grow slightly over several simulated months due to interest
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a savings balance over time to a growing chart showing added interest
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in simple terms, what interest is and why it makes saved money grow

misconception_flags: believes a saved balance stays exactly the same forever with no growth from interest

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
